text:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync — Cloud marketplace syndication + HW SI bundle for OpenSage weights. Thinking concurrent marketplace listing + joint PR but need licensing + export checks. Draft doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partners/pages/opensage-bundle
Ethan (legal): Can you paste the license clause we plan to offer? we need to confirm re-distribution rights and attribution. cc @LegalBot
Maya (partnerships): Short version: "Redistribution permitted for hosted inference; end-user hardware bundles require partner attestation; no resale of raw weights." (draft)
Ethan (legal): That still might flag with some hardware partners. need explicit export control clause + warranty limits. I'll add a paragraph. Also need TOU for marketplace SKU.
Jonas (eng): From infra side: marketplace SKU requires a container + model artifact checksum + quantized variants. We can support 4-bit and 8-bit variants. We'll need final artifact by next Tue to hit the release window.
Priya (product): Important: cadence for canary rollout. Recommend staged availability: beta -> invited customers -> general. Also let's pin pricing banding for dedicated vs hosted.
Marco (HW Partner): Marco here from EdgeFoundry. We're ok with hosted inference but we insist on not distributing raw FP32 weights on our retail SKU. We also need co-branding and a joint support matrix. Is that in the doc?
Maya (partnerships): Not yet — adding now. @Marco thanks. I'll add co-branding guidelines and support SLAs. Also adding embargo window alignment for announcement.
Lena (marketing): For announcement: prefer a 2-week embargo after mutual approval. We can do joint blog + marketplace listing + partner quote. Need final logos + one-liner from partner by EOD Wed.
Ethan (legal): Uploading revised clause here: `https://drive.redwood/legal/opensage-redistribution-v2.docx` — key points: redistribution allowed for integrated HW bundles only after partner attestation; explicit export compliance representation required; indemnity carve-outs for model misuse.
LegalBot: Automated note: Please run export-control-check against vendor list: `tools/export-scan --model OpenSage --partners EdgeFoundry` — results due in 48h.
Jonas (eng): Two technical asks: 1) manifest schema: `model.json` must include `checksum`, `quantization`, `license_id`. 2) compatibility test: we need a tiny smoke test script in repo.
Priya (product): I'll draft the rollout playbook and the test checklist. tagging @Jonas to collaborate on smoke test steps.
Maya (partnerships): Next steps: Ethan to finalize legal text by Thu, Marco to confirm co-branding assets by Wed EOD, Jonas to produce manifest + smoke test by Tue, Lena to prepare copy and embargo plan. Can we confirm milestones here? :calendar:
Marco (HW Partner): Confirmed for Wed EOD on assets. Happy to share quote. Also will ask our export team for the attestation form.
Ethan (legal): I'll push final legal by Thu morning. If export scan flags anything, we'll loop in compliance.
DevOpsBot: Package `opensage-hw-bundle-v1` uploaded to s3://partner-bundles/opensage/v1 — checksum `sha256:abc123...` :white_check_mark:
Maya (partnerships): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the doc and circulate the final playbook. If anything blocks, please flag in this thread. :sparkles:
